user.title: Roborock account
user.description: Choose the Roborock account that owns the camera vacuum.

pattern.title: Video pattern
pattern.description: Draw the same pattern you use in the Roborock app, written as digits. The dots are numbered left to right from the top: 1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9. The top row left to right is 123. Use 4 to 9 dots, with no repeats, and include every dot the line passes through. Only the digest the vacuum requires is stored.

error.invalid_pattern: Enter the pattern as 4 to 9 digits from 1 to 9, with no repeated dots. The grid is 1 2 3, 4 5 6, 7 8 9.

abort.no_roborock: Add the built-in Roborock integration and wait until it is running before adding a camera.
abort.already_configured: This Roborock account already has a camera integration.

init.title: Video pattern
init.description: Leave the field blank to keep the current pattern.

data_description.camera_pin: Same 3x3 pattern as the Roborock app, written as digits. The dots are 1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9. Leave blank to keep the current pattern. Only the digest the vacuum requires is stored.

error.invalid_pattern: Enter the pattern as 4 to 9 digits from 1 to 9, with no repeated dots. The grid is 1 2 3, 4 5 6, 7 8 9.

camera_pin_required.message: Set the Roborock video pattern in the integration options before viewing the camera.

camera_answer_timeout.message: The vacuum did not return a camera stream in time.
